title: Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency Additional Deposit: How the Amount Is Figured
content:
**Admission agreement financial schedule, additional deposits — Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency.**

(a) The additional deposit equals the deposit days times the per-day deposit rate, plus the recurring-service allowance and the personal-item allowance, less the deposit balance recorded on the agreement, never below zero, rounded half up to the cent once, on the final figure; it is paid into the agreement's security deposit by the resident or representative, and where it is zero nothing is paid.

(b) The recurring-service allowance and the personal-item allowance secure one month of the ancillary charges the center bills the resident in arrears on the resident's ancillary account (**Ancillary and Optional Services Billing**).

(c) The per-day deposit rate is the daily rate of the deposit tier under the deposit schedule less the insurer's daily benefit, never below zero, the benefit being taken off the daily rate before the rate is multiplied by the deposit days.

(d) Within the last given number of months means that fewer than that many whole calendar months separate the entry's date from the day the deposit is worked out.

(e) The deposit days are the security deposit days of the agreement's tier (the tier's deposit terms).

(f) The deposit tier is the tier of the agreement's admission-month charge, the tier the deposit was first set for.

(g) The deposit schedule is the one in effect on the agreement's admission date: the current private pay schedule for an admission on or after its effective date, 1 July 2026, and the preceding schedule otherwise.

(h) The insurer's daily benefit is nothing, the deposit being figured on the full daily rate.

(i) The recurring-service allowance is one month of every recurring service billed to the resident within the last twelve months, at the price schedule's monthly charge for that service on the resident's Ancillary and Optional Services Billing account.

(j) The personal-item allowance is nothing.

| Accommodation tier | Preceding schedule (effective 1 July 2025), USD per day | Current schedule (effective 1 July 2026), USD per day |
|---|---|---|
| Semi-Private Long-Term Care Room | 384.00 | 398.00 |
| Semi-Private Secure Memory Care Room | 412.00 | 427.00 |
| Private Long-Term Care Room | 421.00 | 436.00 |
| Private Secure Memory Care Room | 449.00 | 465.00 |
| Private Bariatric Care Room | 466.00 | 482.00 |
| Private Suite with Sitting Area | 497.00 | 514.00 |

**Hypothetical worked example.** An admission to the Semi-Private Secure Memory Care Room before 1 July 2026, so the deposit tier's rate is the preceding 412.00; deposit days 30; insurer's benefit nothing; an oxygen concentrator billed on the resident's Ancillary Account, Private Pay within the last twelve months, at 185.00 a month; personal items nothing; deposit held 12,360.00. 30 times 412.00 is 12,360.00; plus 185.00 is 12,545.00; less 12,360.00 leaves 185.00.
